title: SVB Financial Group Plans to Raise $2.25 Billion in Stock
body: Silicon Valley Bank parent SVB Financial Group announced plans Wednesday to raise approximately $2.25 billion in capital after selling its available-for-sale bond portfolio at a significant loss.

title: SVB Stock Plunges 60% as Bank Discloses Losses on Bond Portfolio
body: Shares of SVB Financial Group fell more than 60% Thursday after the bank disclosed it had sold $21 billion of bonds at a $1.8 billion loss and planned to raise fresh capital.

title: JPMorgan Analysts Say SVB Situation Is Idiosyncratic Not Systemic
body: JPMorgan Chase analysts said the Silicon Valley Bank situation appears idiosyncratic, driven by its high concentration of venture capital clients, and does not signal broader banking stress.

title: Wells Fargo Bank Shares Fall Amid Regional Bank Contagion Fears
body: Wells Fargo stock dropped 4% amid broader concern about regional bank exposure to held-to-maturity bond portfolios as interest rates have risen sharply since 2022.

title: Bank of America and Citigroup Stocks Slide on SVB Contagion Risk
body: Shares of Bank of America and Citigroup fell 3-4% Thursday as investors reassessed the health of bank bond portfolios across the sector, though analysts noted these institutions are far better diversified than SVB.

title: Federal Regulators Seize Silicon Valley Bank in Largest US Bank Failure Since 2008
body: Federal regulators shut down Silicon Valley Bank on Friday and placed it under FDIC receivership after a bank run accelerated following Wednesday's capital raise announcement.

title: Goldman Sachs Says Banking Stress Unlikely to Spill to Larger Banks
body: Goldman Sachs economists wrote that stress at SVB and other smaller banks with concentrated depositor bases is unlikely to spread to larger diversified institutions given their strong capital ratios.

title: JPMorgan Chase Sees Opportunity as SVB Clients Seek Safe Harbor
body: JPMorgan Chase and other major banks are reportedly receiving calls from SVB clients looking for emergency alternatives as the FDIC works through the resolution process.

title: Treasury and Fed Work Over Weekend on SVB Depositor Protection Plan
body: Treasury Secretary Yellen, Federal Reserve Chair Powell, and FDIC Chairman Gruenberg conferred over the weekend on options to protect SVB depositors amid fears of broader bank runs.

title: Signature Bank Closed by New York Regulators in Second Bank Failure This Week
body: New York state regulators closed Signature Bank on Sunday evening citing systemic risk concerns in the second major bank failure of the week. The Federal Reserve created a new Bank Term Funding Program.

title: Fed Creates Bank Term Funding Program to Backstop Deposits
body: The Federal Reserve announced a new Bank Term Funding Program allowing banks to borrow at par against Treasury and agency securities, effectively providing a liquidity backstop to prevent further bank runs.

title: Bank Stocks Rally as Fed Backstop Eases Systemic Fears
body: Bank of America, Citigroup, JPMorgan and Wells Fargo stocks rebounded Monday after the Federal Reserve's emergency backstop program reassured markets that deposit runs would not spread to larger banks.

title: Citibank CEO Jane Fraser Says Citi Has Zero Direct SVB Exposure
body: Citigroup CEO Jane Fraser issued a statement Monday morning reassuring investors that Citi has no direct exposure to SVB or Signature Bank and that its deposit base is well diversified globally.

title: Credit Suisse Shares Hit Record Low Amid Banking Sector Stress
body: Credit Suisse shares fell to a record low as European banking stocks extended losses in sympathy with the US regional bank crisis though analysts noted different underlying causes.

title: JPMorgan Chase Earnings Preview: Analysts Raise Estimates on Deposit Inflows
body: Analysts at Barclays raised earnings estimates for JPMorgan Chase ahead of Q1 earnings citing evidence of significant deposit inflows from fleeing SVB and Signature Bank clients.

title: Goldman Sachs Downgrades US Regional Bank Outlook to Underweight
body: Goldman Sachs equity strategists downgraded their outlook on US regional banks to underweight citing ongoing uncertainty about deposit stability and unrealised bond portfolio losses.

title: Wells Fargo Assures Investors Its Bond Portfolio Risk Is Manageable
body: Wells Fargo CFO Mike Santomassimo said the bank's held-to-maturity bond portfolio poses manageable risk, with unrealised losses totalling $34 billion but no plan to force sales.

title: Bank of America Reports Strong Deposit Retention Despite Industry Turmoil
body: Bank of America said retail deposit outflows have been minimal during the banking sector turmoil and that BofA gained market share from distressed regional banks.

title: Fed Rate Hike Expectations Revised Lower After SVB Crisis
body: Futures markets now price only a 25 basis point rate hike at the March Fed meeting, down from 50 bps expected before the SVB crisis, as markets expect the Fed to pause tightening to support banking stability.

title: Regional Bank Crisis Recap: Winners and Losers After Ten Days of Turmoil
body: A week and a half after SVB's collapse, large diversified banks like JPMorgan, Bank of America and Citigroup emerged as relative winners, while regional banks with concentrated deposits and bond losses continued to struggle.
